import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final int MOD = 1000000007;
    static long n;
    static int K, total, currentIndex, m;
    static int[] digits = new int[110];

    static class Matrix {
        int[][] v = new int[35][35];

        Matrix() {
            for (int i = 0; i < v.length; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < v[0].length; j++) {
                    v[i][j] = 0;
                }
            }
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix b) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix();
            for (int k = 0; k <= K; k++) {
                for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
                    if (v[i][k] != 0) {
                        for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                            if (b.v[k][j] != 0) {
                                res.v[i][j] = (int)((1L * v[i][k] * b.v[k][j] + res.v[i][j]) % MOD);
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static void convertNumber(long number) {
        long temp = number;
        m = 0;
        while (temp != 0) {
            digits[++m] = (int)(temp % K);
            temp /= K;
        }
        // reverse digits
        for (int i = 1; i <= m / 2; i++) {
            int tmp = digits[i];
            digits[i] = digits[m - i + 1];
            digits[m - i + 1] = tmp;
        }
    }

    static void update(int[] x, int y, int m) {
        x[0] += y;
        if (x[0] >= m) x[0] -= m;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextInt();

        convertNumber(n);

        Matrix[][] sMatrix = new Matrix[m + 1][K + 1];
        Matrix[][] prefixMat = new Matrix[m][K + 1];
        Matrix[][] suffixMat = new Matrix[m][K + 1];

        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                sMatrix[i][j] = new Matrix();
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= K; j++) {
                sMatrix[0][i].v[j][j] = 1;
                sMatrix[0][i].v[i][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int idx = i - 1;
            prefixMat[idx][0] = sMatrix[idx][0];
            suffixMat[idx][K] = sMatrix[idx][K];

            for (int j = 1; j < K; j++) {
                prefixMat[idx][j] = prefixMat[idx][j - 1].multiply(sMatrix[idx][j]);
            }
            for (int j = K - 1; j >= 0; j--) {
                suffixMat[idx][j] = sMatrix[idx][j].multiply(suffixMat[idx][j + 1]);
            }
            for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                if (j != 0) {
                    sMatrix[i][j] = suffixMat[idx][j].multiply(prefixMat[idx][j - 1]);
                } else {
                    sMatrix[i][j] = suffixMat[idx][j];
                }
            }
        }

        Matrix result = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            result.v[i][i] = 1;
        }

        int[] currentIndexArr = new int[1];
        currentIndexArr[0] = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= m; i++) {
            int digit = digits[i];
            if (digit != 0) {
                if (currentIndexArr[0] + digit - 1 >= K) {
                    for (int j = currentIndexArr[0]; j < K; j++) {
                        result = result.multiply(sMatrix[m - i][j]);
                    }
                    for (int j = 0; j <= (currentIndexArr[0] + digit - 1) - K; j++) {
                        result = result.multiply(sMatrix[m - i][j]);
                    }
                } else {
                    for (int j = currentIndexArr[0]; j <= currentIndexArr[0] + digit - 1; j++) {
                        result = result.multiply(sMatrix[m - i][j]);
                    }
                }
                update(currentIndexArr, digit, K);
            }
        }

        total = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i <= K; i++) {
            total += result.v[i][K];
            if (total >= MOD) total -= MOD;
        }

        System.out.println(total);
        sc.close();
    }
}
